mentions.name: Pile
mentions.description: A Chrome extension for managing open tabs: when you close all your tabs, it automatically saves them to a to-read list so nothing gets lost. Recently approved on the Chrome Web Store.
mentions.problem: Too many open tabs are hard to manage in a sane way.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to build a way to manage all my open tabs in a sane way! So you close all the tabs and it automatically saves them all to a to-read list.  It just got approved on the chrome web store, and I'd love your thoughts
mentions.author: chandra381
